name: schemasketch-mcp-server

tools.name: get_dbml_syntax_guide
tools.description: Read this before writing or editing any DBML — the exact syntax SchemaSketch accepts, with a full example.

tools.name: list_diagrams
tools.description: List the signed-in user's saved diagrams (id, name, last updated).

tools.name: get_diagram
tools.description: Fetch one diagram by id, including its full DBML source and table positions.

diagram_id.description: The diagram id (a UUID), from list_diagrams.

tools.name: validate_dbml
tools.description: Parse DBML and report syntax errors plus semantic warnings (duplicate names, dangling refs, unrecognized/mismatched types) before saving it. Read-only — never touches the server.

tools.name: create_diagram
tools.description: Create a new diagram. The DBML is validated first: syntax errors or relationships to missing tables/columns mean nothing is saved; warnings are returned with the result.

name.description: Diagram title, shown on the dashboard.

dbml_source.description: Initial DBML text. Empty diagram if omitted.

tools.name: update_diagram
tools.description: Replace a diagram's DBML source (and/or rename it). This overwrites the whole source — fetch it with get_diagram first if you need to edit rather than replace it outright, and pass its version as base_version so you never overwrite someone else's newer change. New DBML is validated first: errors mean nothing is saved; warnings are returned with the result.

diagram_id.description: The diagram id (a UUID), from list_diagrams.

dbml_source.description: New full DBML text. Omit to leave unchanged.

name.description: New title. Omit to leave unchanged.

base_version.description: The diagram's `version` from get_diagram. When given, the update is refused if someone else saved since, instead of overwriting their change. Recommended whenever you edit.

table.description: For a column: the table it belongs to (old or new name).

renames.description: Tables, columns, enums and table groups this edit renames. Always list them: without it a rename can look like a removed column plus a new one, and a migration generated from the diagram would drop the column and its data instead of renaming it.

tools.name: delete_diagram
tools.description: Permanently delete a diagram. This cannot be undone — confirm with the user before calling it.

diagram_id.description: The diagram id (a UUID), from list_diagrams.

tools.name: export_sql
tools.description: Generate CREATE TABLE / ALTER TABLE SQL DDL for a diagram, in a given dialect.

diagram_id.description: A saved diagram to export (its UUID).

dbml_source.description: Or export unsaved DBML text directly instead of a saved diagram.

tools.name: export_laravel_migrations
tools.description: Generate Laravel migration files (one per table, plus a foreign-keys migration) for a diagram.

diagram_id.description: A saved diagram to export (its UUID).

dbml_source.description: Or export unsaved DBML text directly instead of a saved diagram.

tools.name: export_laravel_models
tools.description: Generate Laravel Eloquent model files (fillable, casts, and inferred relationships including belongsToMany through plain pivot tables) for a diagram.

diagram_id.description: A saved diagram to export (its UUID).

dbml_source.description: Or export unsaved DBML text directly instead of a saved diagram.

laravel_version.description: Target Laravel major version. 10 emits the legacy `protected $casts` property; 11+ emits the newer `casts(): array` method (not recognized by Eloquent 10).

tools.name: export_mermaid
tools.description: Generate Mermaid erDiagram syntax for a diagram.

diagram_id.description: A saved diagram to export (its UUID).

dbml_source.description: Or export unsaved DBML text directly instead of a saved diagram.

tools.name: export_plantuml
tools.description: Generate PlantUML entity syntax for a diagram.

diagram_id.description: A saved diagram to export (its UUID).

dbml_source.description: Or export unsaved DBML text directly instead of a saved diagram.

tools.name: import_sql
tools.description: Convert CREATE TABLE / ALTER TABLE SQL DDL into DBML text. Read-only — never touches the server; pass the result to create_diagram or update_diagram to actually save it.

sql.description: The SQL text to convert (CREATE TABLE / ALTER TABLE ... FOREIGN KEY statements).

tools.name: import_mermaid
tools.description: Convert Mermaid erDiagram syntax into DBML text. Read-only — never touches the server; pass the result to create_diagram or update_diagram to actually save it.

mermaid.description: The Mermaid erDiagram source to convert.

tools.name: import_plantuml
tools.description: Convert PlantUML entity syntax into DBML text. Read-only — never touches the server; pass the result to create_diagram or update_diagram to actually save it.

plantuml.description: The PlantUML entity source to convert.
